scope_note: Solver self-consistency benchmarks against exact analytical references. Not a validation against measured vehicle data.

benchmarks.name: Quarter-car eigenanalysis
benchmarks.description: Solver vs exact coupled 2-DOF characteristic roots. The uncoupled sqrt(k_w/m_s)/2pi value is reported separately as an approximation.

checks.reference: Roots of the coupled 2-DOF characteristic polynomial (exact). Uncoupled sqrt(k_w/m_s)/2pi is an approximation that neglects tire stiffness and unsprung mass.

benchmarks.name: Damper cycle energy
benchmarks.description: Linear c_eff = c and bilinear (c_c + c_r)/2 through the Wave 5A phase integral.

checks.reference: Exact: (c_c + c_r)/2 from the half-cycle energy split

benchmarks.name: Tire cornering sign
benchmarks.description: Standard .tir with PKY1 = -15.0 gives positive cornering stiffness. Calspan TTC fit is IN_PROGRESS.

checks.reference: Wave 5A abs(PKY1) fix. Peak grip is the model output for this synthetic .tir, not a measurement.

pending.reason: Needs a licensed Calspan TTC dataset; not in this repository.

benchmarks.name: Full-car heave mode
benchmarks.description: Symmetric 4-corner heave vs the exact quarter-car hand calculation, plus roll/pitch symmetry.

checks.reference: Symmetric 4-corner heave equals a quarter car carrying m_s/4 (exact).
